**Runtime:** 1:05:09

**Songs:** 60




The Downers All the Way Down Power Hour is a power hour for drinking alone together. It is made of 60 sad songs that are a blast to scream along to with friends but also good for drinking by yourself after a rough week out in the world. This is the fastest-built Friendsgiving (though there was no Friendsgiving this year) power hour ever. The raw lack of concern for choice of quality songs and abject disregard for precision in the transitions helps us to fully feel the bitter apathy of the purposeless, meaningless world we live in. Hope you enjoy! 

Love,
Luke
